product_one_liner.value: Sitetracker is an asset-lifecycle management platform for infrastructure owners, operators, contractors and other stakeholders to plan, build, operate and maintain critical infrastructure projects and assets.

pricing_page.notes: The company homepage does not expose a public pricing link; pricing is handled through a demo/contact flow.

eng_blog.notes: The accessible public content is marketing/product content; no qualifying engineering blog with at least two build-focused posts was found.

public_docs.notes: The help subdomain resolves to a login/EDU gateway rather than a public multi-article documentation site.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board lists an AI Developer role and Salesforce Administrator roles labeled Agentic AI.

model_provider.notes: Public product, help, security/trust and marketing materials reviewed did not identify a model provider used by the product.

compliance_certs.notes: The cited company post names SOC 1 & 2 and ISO 27001; only the requested certification names are included.

last_funding.notes: The September 2022 financing comprised $66M Series D equity plus $30M debt, reported together as $96M.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round is dated September 2022, outside the 18-month window before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live postings include Strategic Enterprise Account Executive and Sr. Enterprise Sales Development Representative.

launched_6mo.notes: The latest clearly dated major product launch found was Scout on 2026-04-08, before the six-month window beginning 2026-05-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Spencer Earp's profile states that he became Chief Revenue Officer at Sitetracker in March 2026.
